title: Delete or merge user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart — it wholesale duplicates user_database_dataclass_test.dart's 8 DataClass groups
why: user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart's own doc header claims to cover tables 'not yet covered' by user_database_dataclass_test.dart, but both files define groups named Account/LearnerProfile/CurriculumTrack/CurriculumScope/ProfileProgram/DailyPlan/LearningLedgerData/Goal DataClass and both exercise the same toJson/fromJson, copyWith, toCompanion/copyWithCompanion, equality/hashCode/toString, toColumns surface per table with only the seed data changed — the file's stated reason to exist is false, and it is the single biggest file in the batch (1176 lines). Two smaller copy-paste symptoms of the same root cause: user_database_companion_coverage_test.dart defines two different 'CompletionEventsCompanion' groups (346, 389) instead of one, and user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart has a 'Completions insert without profileId throws' test (1130) that is byte-for-byte identical to the 'CompletionEvents' test 9 lines below it (1139) — evidence the second was pasted without renaming the target. Separately, the manager-API tests for outbox, textDownloadStatuses and sacredWindowEntries are each written twice — once in user_database_companion_coverage_test.dart (lines 901-1079) and again in user_database_dataclass_extended_test.dart (lines 1526-1611). Every future schema change to these tables now requires edits in two places to stay in sync, and CI spends time re-running ~1200+ lines of assertions with zero incremental defect-catching power over the surviving file.
recommendation: Diff user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart against user_database_dataclass_test.dart; port any assertion genuinely absent from the latter (if any), then delete user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart. Rename or remove the second 'CompletionEventsCompanion' group in user_database_companion_coverage_test.dart and fix the Completions/CompletionEvents copy-paste. Keep the outbox/textDownloadStatuses/sacredWindowEntries manager tests in exactly one file.
acceptance_criteria: user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart no longer exists (or contains zero groups whose name and table also appear in user_database_dataclass_test.dart).
outbox/textDownloadStatuses/sacredWindowEntries manager tests exist in exactly one of the two files.
`flutter test test/core/database/` passes with the same or greater table coverage after the merge.
